blocking_finding.location: ci/checks/anti-case-lock.sh count_literal() (lines 61-70), instantiated for every denylist entry via count_src()/count_web(); same shape in read_baseline() (lines 82-86)
blocking_finding.issue: count_literal() is a 4-stage pipeline (grep -rn ... | grep -v __tests__ | grep -vE .test. | grep -vE comment-strip | wc -l | tr -d) executed under the script's own `set -euo pipefail` (line 50). When the FIRST grep in the pipe finds zero matches (a literal's code-only count has genuinely dropped to 0 — the exact 'erodes to zero' outcome the gate's own contract (§ header 'erodes-or-steady', NF-5, FR-3 <=-semantics) is supposed to CELEBRATE), that grep exits 1. Under pipefail the WHOLE pipeline's exit status becomes non-zero, and under set -e that non-zero status inside the command substitution `count="$(count_src ...)"` kills the calling function's compound command — the enclosing anti-case-lock.sh process exits immediately with rc=1, mid-script, with NO 'FAIL'/'PASS' message and no explanation. I reproduced this live and reverted cleanly: temporarily renamed the sole gw-approval-threshold occurrence in src/core/dmn-gateway.ts (a legitimate future de-TEL-ization edit that the gate is explicitly designed to reward), re-ran `bash ci/checks/anti-case-lock.sh` on the modified tree — it printed Phase 1 PASS, Phase 2 lines for role-approver/soglasovanie/tel-approval/telLinear/e-larina/e-orlov/approvalRequired all OK, then STOPPED (no gw-approval-threshold line, no aggregate line, no final verdict) with exit code 1. This is silent, unexplained CI red on the exact scenario the gate exists to allow. The bug is structural to the shared count_literal function, not literal-specific — any future task that fully removes ANY ONE of the 8 denylist literals from the codebase (a strict subset already happened historically per T-0575's own trajectory of driving literals toward zero) will hit this same crash. I restored the file immediately after reproducing (git status clean, verified via `git diff --stat` and a second clean production run showing aggregate 19/19 PASS).
blocking_finding.why_blocking: This directly contradicts the task's own central design claim (ADR §1, NF-5, spec FR-3): '<=, не строгое уменьшение — T-0576 сам не обязан уменьшать остаток, но будущие задачи обязаны либо не расти, либо уменьшать' (erodes-or-steady). The mechanism as shipped cannot actually pass once any literal reaches its ideal end-state (0), which is the entire long-term purpose of a 'baseline that only ever shrinks' gate. A future legitimate de-TEL-ization PR that fully eliminates e.g. e-larina/e-orlov from src/ would see this required fitness check die with an inexplicable rc=1, block their merge, and cost them a debugging session to discover a pre-existing infra bug is at fault — exactly the kind of self-inflicted friction D-064 is trying to eliminate, landing in the CI gate meant to enforce D-064 itself.
blocking_finding.suggested_fix: Neutralize the zero-match pipe failure before wc -l consumes it — e.g. `grep -rn ... "${root}" "${include_args[@]}" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '__tests__' | grep -vE '\.test\.(ts|tsx|jsx|js)' | grep -vE ':[0-9]+:[[:space:]]*(//|\*|/\*)' | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]'` needs either `grep ... || true` on the FIRST grep in the chain (the one whose rc=1-on-no-match propagates), or restructure with `grep -c` semantics, or wrap the whole pipeline call site with a rc-tolerant pattern (e.g. `count="$(count_src "${literal}" || true)"` — though that alone does not help while pipefail is active inside the function itself; the fix belongs INSIDE count_literal). --self-test does not currently cover this path because none of its three planted fixtures exercise the zero-count case for the SPECIFIC literal being queried (every self-test fixture plants exactly one occurrence and asserts count==1; none asserts a literal string with ZERO occurrences in a tree still produces count==0 and a live script that keeps running).
